```{r Random_Forest_Model}
# ===================================================================
# ===== MODEL RANDOM FOREST (METODOLOGI OOB) - FINAL 70:20:10 SPLIT =====
# ===================================================================
# MAPPING:
# 70% (Latih) -> rf_train_data
# 20% (Uji)   -> rf_test_data
# 10% (Validasi) -> rf_validation_data (Untuk konsistensi output)
# ===================================================================

# -------------------------------
# 0. Load Library
# -------------------------------
packages <- c("randomForest", "caret", "ggplot2", "pROC", "dplyr", "tikzDevice")
cat("Mengecek dan menginstall paket yang dibutuhkan...\n")
for(pkg in packages) {
  if (!require(pkg, character.only = TRUE)) {
    cat(sprintf("Paket '%s' tidak ditemukan. Menginstall...\n", pkg))
    install.packages(pkg, dependencies = TRUE)
  }
  library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
}
cat("Semua paket berhasil di-load.\n\n")

set.seed(123) # reproduksibilitas

# -------------------------------
# 1. LOAD DATA DARI SKRIP REGRESI LOGISTIK
# -------------------------------

if(file.exists("Data_Skripsi_Fixed_8vars.RData")) {
  load("Data_Skripsi_Fixed_8vars.RData")
  cat("SUKSES: Data berhasil dimuat dari 'Data_Skripsi_Fixed_8vars.RData'.\n")
  cat("Menerapkan proporsi: Latih (70%), Uji (20%), Validasi (10%)\n")
} else {
  stop("ERROR: File 'Data_Skripsi_Fixed_8vars.RData' tidak ditemukan.\nSilakan jalankan Chunk Regresi Logistik terlebih dahulu.")
}

# --- Mapping Variabel Sesuai Permintaan Latih:Uji:Validasi (70:20:10) ---
rf_train_data      <- train_data_logreg # 70% (Latih)
rf_test_data       <- test_data_logreg  # 20% (Uji Akhir)
rf_validation_data <- val_data_logreg   # 10% (Validasi/Konsistensi Output)

cat(sprintf("Data Latih (Train) : %d baris (70%%)\n", nrow(rf_train_data)))
cat(sprintf("Data Uji (Test)    : %d baris (20%%)\n", nrow(rf_test_data)))
cat(sprintf("Data Validasi (Val): %d baris (10%%)\n", nrow(rf_validation_data)))


# -------------------------------
# 2. Pastikan Target Adalah Faktor
# -------------------------------
levels_y <- sort(unique(rf_train_data$y))
rf_train_data$y      <- factor(rf_train_data$y, levels = levels_y)
rf_test_data$y       <- factor(rf_test_data$y, levels = levels_y)
rf_validation_data$y <- factor(rf_validation_data$y, levels = levels_y)


# -------------------------------
# 3. Grid Search Menggunakan OOB Error + Parameter Tambahan
# -------------------------------
# Parameter yang akan di-tuning:
# 1. ntree: Jumlah pohon
# 2. mtry: Jumlah fitur acak per split
# 3. nodesize (minsplit): Ukuran minimum node terminal
# 4. maxnodes (maxdepth): Jumlah maksimum terminal node

ntree_values <- c(100, 300, 500)

# Menentukan mtry
num_predictors <- ncol(rf_train_data) - 1 
mtry_values_awal <- c(2, 3, 4) 
mtry_values <- unique(mtry_values_awal[mtry_values_awal <= num_predictors])

# Menentukan nodesize (mirip minsplit di DT)
nodesize_values <- c(25, 50, 75) 

# Menentukan maxnodes (mirip maxdepth di DT)
maxnodes_values <- c(8,16,32) 

results_df <- data.frame(
  ntree = integer(),
  mtry = integer(),
  nodesize = integer(),
  maxnodes = character(), 
  OOB_Accuracy = double(),
  OOB_F1 = double()
)

cat("\nMemulai Grid Search (menggunakan OOB Error pada Data Latih)...\n")

total_iter <- length(ntree_values) * length(mtry_values) * length(nodesize_values) * length(maxnodes_values)
iter_count <- 0

for(nt in ntree_values){
  for(mt in mtry_values){
    for(ns in nodesize_values){
      for(mn in maxnodes_values){
        
        iter_count <- iter_count + 1
        # Handle maxnodes NULL
        current_mn <- if(is.null(mn)) NULL else as.integer(mn)
        mn_label <- if(is.null(mn)) "Unlimited" else as.character(mn)
        
        # Train Model
        rf_model <- randomForest(y ~ ., data=rf_train_data, 
                                 ntree=nt, 
                                 mtry=mt, 
                                 nodesize=ns, 
                                 maxnodes=current_mn,
                                 importance=FALSE) 
        
        # Ambil Confusion Matrix OOB
        cm_oob <- rf_model$confusion
        
        if (nrow(cm_oob) < 2 || ncol(cm_oob) < 2) next

        TN <- cm_oob[1, 1]
        FP <- cm_oob[1, 2]
        FN <- cm_oob[2, 1]
        TP <- cm_oob[2, 2]
        
        acc  <- (TP + TN) / (TP + TN + FP + FN)
        prec <- TP / (TP + FP)
        rec  <- TP / (TP + FN)
        f1   <- 2 * (prec * rec) / (prec + rec)
        
        # Handle NaN
        acc  <- ifelse(is.nan(acc), 0, acc)
        f1   <- ifelse(is.nan(f1), 0, f1)

        results_df <- rbind(results_df, data.frame(
          ntree = nt,
          mtry = mt,
          nodesize = ns,
          maxnodes = mn_label,
          OOB_Accuracy = round(acc, 4),
          OOB_F1 = round(f1, 4)
        ))
      }
    }
  }
}
cat("Grid Search Selesai!\n\n")

# Urutkan berdasarkan F1 lalu Accuracy
results_df <- results_df[order(-results_df$OOB_F1, -results_df$OOB_Accuracy), ]
print("Hasil Grid Search (Top 10 berdasarkan OOB):")
print(head(results_df, 10))

best_params <- results_df[1, ]
cat(sprintf("\nKombinasi Terbaik (OOB):\nntree=%d, mtry=%d, nodesize=%d, maxnodes=%s\nOOB F1=%.4f, OOB Accuracy=%.4f\n",
            best_params$ntree, best_params$mtry, best_params$nodesize, best_params$maxnodes, best_params$OOB_F1, best_params$OOB_Accuracy))


# -------------------------------
# 4. Latih Model Terbaik
# -------------------------------
cat("\nMelatih model terbaik menggunakan parameter optimal...\n")

# Convert maxnodes label back to value
final_mn <- if(best_params$maxnodes == "Unlimited") NULL else as.integer(best_params$maxnodes)

best_model_rf <- randomForest(y ~ ., data=rf_train_data, 
                              ntree=best_params$ntree, 
                              mtry=best_params$mtry, 
                              nodesize=best_params$nodesize,
                              maxnodes=final_mn,
                              importance=TRUE) # Hidupkan importance untuk plot akhir

cat("\n--- Ringkasan Model Final (OOB Estimate) ---\n")
print(best_model_rf)


# ===================================================================
# ===== FUNGSI EVALUASI (TERMASUK VALIDASI 10%) =====
# ===================================================================
evaluate_model_rf <- function(model, dataset, dataset_name="Data"){
  positive_class <- as.character(levels_y[2])
  
  pred_class <- factor(predict(model, newdata=dataset, type="class"), levels=levels_y)
  pred_prob <- predict(model, newdata=dataset, type="prob")[,positive_class]

  # Confusion Matrix & Classification Report
  cm <- confusionMatrix(pred_class, dataset$y, positive=positive_class)
  cat(sprintf("\n--- Confusion Matrix & Classification Report: %s ---\n", dataset_name))
  print(cm)
  writeLines(capture.output(print(cm)), paste0("classification_report_RF_", dataset_name, ".txt"))
  
  # --- PLOT Heatmap CM ---
  df_cm <- as.data.frame(table(Actual=dataset$y, Predicted=pred_class))
  colnames(df_cm) <- c("Actual","Predicted","Count")
  
  p_cm <- ggplot(df_cm, aes(x=Predicted, y=Actual, fill=Count)) +
    geom_tile(color="black") +
    geom_text(aes(label=Count), color="white", size=6) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low="lightblue", high="darkblue") +
    labs(x="Kelas Prediksi", y="Kelas Aktual") + 
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_blank(), legend.position = "none") 
    
  print(p_cm) 
  ggsave(paste0("ConfusionMatrix_RF_", dataset_name, ".png"), p_cm, width=7, height=5, dpi=300)
  
  # Simpan ke TeX
  tex_file_cm <- paste0("ConfusionMatrix_RF_", dataset_name, ".tex")
  tryCatch({
    tikz(file = tex_file_cm, width = 7, height = 5.5, verbose = FALSE)
    print(p_cm) 
    dev.off()
  }, error = function(e) { message(e) })
  
  # --- ROC & AUC ---
  if (length(unique(dataset$y)) > 1) {
    roc_curve <- roc(response=dataset$y, predictor=pred_prob, levels=levels_y, direction="<")
    auc_val <- auc(roc_curve)
    cat("AUC", dataset_name, ":", round(auc_val,4), "\n")
    
    # Plot ROC 
    plot_title_roc <- ""
    plot(roc_curve, main = plot_title_roc, col = "blue", lwd = 2, legacy.axes = TRUE)
    abline(a = 0, b = 1, lty = 2, col = "red")
    text(x=0.5, y=0.5, paste("AUC:", round(auc_val, 3)), col="blue", cex=1.2)
    
    # Simpan PNG
    png_file <- paste0("ROC_RF_", dataset_name, ".png")
    png(png_file, width=800, height=600)
    plot(roc_curve, main = plot_title_roc, col = "blue", lwd = 2, legacy.axes = TRUE)
    abline(a = 0, b = 1, lty = 2, col = "red")
    text(x=0.5, y=0.5, paste("AUC:", round(auc_val, 3)), col="blue", cex=1.2)
    dev.off()
    
    # Simpan TeX
    tex_file <- paste0("ROC_RF_", dataset_name, ".tex")
    tryCatch({
      tikz(file = tex_file, width = 7, height = 5.5, verbose = FALSE)
      plot(roc_curve, main = plot_title_roc, col = "blue", lwd = 2, legacy.axes = TRUE)
      abline(a = 0, b = 1, lty = 2, col = "red")
      text(x=0.5, y=0.5, paste("AUC:", round(auc_val, 3)), col="blue", cex=1.2)
      dev.off()
    }, error = function(e) { message(e) })
    
  } else {
    cat("AUC tidak bisa dihitung (hanya 1 kelas di data", dataset_name, ")\n")
  }
}


# -------------------------------
# 5. Eksekusi Evaluasi
# -------------------------------
cat("\n\n--- MENGEVALUASI PADA DATA LATIH (70%) ---")
evaluate_model_rf(best_model_rf, rf_train_data, "Train")

cat("\n\n--- MENGEVALUASI PADA DATA VALIDASI (10%) ---")
evaluate_model_rf(best_model_rf, rf_validation_data, "Validation")

cat("\n\n--- MENGEVALUASI PADA DATA UJI (20%) ---")
evaluate_model_rf(best_model_rf, rf_test_data, "Test")


# -------------------------------
# 6. Variable Importance (MODIFIKASI: Console + PNG)
# -------------------------------
cat("\n--- Variable Importance (Nilai Numerik) ---\n")

# 1. Tampilkan Angka di Console
imp_data <- importance(best_model_rf)
print(imp_data)

# 2. Simpan Angka ke CSV (Opsional, berguna untuk laporan)
write.csv(imp_data, "Variable_Importance_Values.csv")

cat("\n--- Membuat Plot Variable Importance ---\n")
plot_title_imp <- ""

# 3. Simpan PNG (Resolusi Tinggi)
png("Variable_Importance_RF.png", width=1200, height=800, res=100)
varImpPlot(best_model_rf, main = plot_title_imp)
dev.off()
cat("SUKSES: Plot Variable Importance disimpan sebagai 'Variable_Importance_RF.png'.\n")

# 4. Simpan TeX (TikZ)
cat("Menyimpan plot VarImp sebagai 'Variable_Importance_RF.tex'...\n")
tryCatch({
  tikz(file = "Variable_Importance_RF.tex", width = 7, height = 5.5, verbose = FALSE)
  varImpPlot(best_model_rf, main = plot_title_imp)
  dev.off()
  cat("Plot .tex (TikZ) berhasil disimpan.\n")
}, error = function(e) {
  message("ERROR: Gagal menyimpan VarImp sebagai TikZ.")
  message(e)
  if(names(dev.cur()) == "tikz output") { dev.off() }
})

# 5. Tampilkan Plot di RStudio
varImpPlot(best_model_rf, main = plot_title_imp)

cat("Semua proses Random Forest selesai.\n")
```
